description: This file defines a controller class `ReturnReason` in the OpenCart admin localization module. It provides functionality for listing, viewing, creating, editing, saving, and deleting return reasons, which are part of the customer returns process. The class handles HTTP requests, loads language strings, manages URL parameters for sorting, ordering, and pagination, interacts with the model to fetch and modify data, and renders views for the return reason management interface.

classes.name: ReturnReason
classes.description: Controller class for managing return reasons in the admin localization section of OpenCart. It provides methods for listing, adding, editing, saving, and deleting return reasons, as well as generating forms and handling AJAX save operations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the list of return reasons, handling sorting, pagination, and links to add/edit/delete.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves the list of return reasons with applied filters and pagination, then renders the list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Constructs the data needed for displaying the list of return reasons, including sorting, ordering, pagination, and URLs.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a return reason, populating data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to save a new or edited return reason, returning success or error JSON.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected return reasons based on submitted data.

methods.name: deleteReturnReasons
methods.description: Handles the deletion of selected return reasons, checks for permission, deletes each selected reason, and returns a JSON response indicating success or error.

methods.name: saveReturnReason
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to save a return reason, validates permissions, deletes return reasons if prompted, and outputs success or error JSON.
